data.action: 抱着膝盖坐在窗台上望向远方
data.description: 【史尔特尔 · 宿舍窗边】罗德岛黄昏的单人宿舍内，史尔特尔双手抱着膝盖坐在窗台上，火红色的长发在夕阳余晖中如流动的余烬。她凝望着窗外荒原上飞掠而过的风滚草，眼神迷茫中带着一丝烦躁——「脑海里的那些记忆碎片又开始吵闹了……博士，别站在门口发呆，过来陪我坐一会儿。」
data.lighting: warm dusk light through the window
data.location: 罗德岛·史尔特尔宿舍窗边
data.promptProse: Surtr sits on the broad dorm windowsill with her knees drawn up, looking across the wasteland with distant, faintly annoyed eyes. Black silk nightdress with champagne-pink trim and the light black robe retain her lounge outfit. The eye-level medium view includes the sill supporting her and the landscape beyond the pane. Warm dusk window light catches red hair and fabric crests, leaving soft folds shaded beneath her encircling arms.
